items.title: DALL·E 2 pre-training mitigations
items.summary: In order to share the magic of DALL·E 2 with a broad audience, we needed to reduce the risks associated with powerful image generation models. To this end, we put various guardrails in place to prevent generated images from violating our content policy.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI分享了关于DALL-E 2图像生成模型在预训练及上线阶段的安全防范措施。为了减少强大生成模型的潜在风险并防止违规内容的产生，官方实施了多项防护机制与内容政策，以平衡技术创新与社会责任。原始信息显示：In order to share the magic of DALL·E 2 with a broad audience, we needed to reduce the risks associated with powerful image generation models. To this end, we put various guardrails in place to prevent generated images from violating our content policy.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“DALL·E 2 pre-training mitigations”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI详细介绍了DALL-E 2在预训练阶段采用的安全缓解措施与内容策略防护机制。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
